description.p: SyMoNeuRaL-View is a proprietary, hardware-accelerated media and IPTV workstation tailored for high-end environments. Engineered natively for Debian Trixie, it provides low-latency stream rendering and seamless background recording.

ul.li: Native XCB platform integration with forced auto-hardware decoding for NVIDIA RTX architectures.
Multi-threaded, deterministic backend for parallel EPG parsing and stable ffmpeg recording management.
Advanced stream ingestion supporting Xtream API, M3U, and XSPF topologies.
